easy.def: Twelve months, or all the seasons in a row.

more.def: A period of twelve months, or the time it takes the Earth to travel once around the sun.
examples: My cousin has lived in Canada for a year.
The Earth takes one year to go around the sun.
This school year, we are learning about the planets.

easy.def: A school book with pictures of the year.

more.def: A book made each year by a school with photos of students and events.
examples: The yearbook has pictures of every class.
She looked at her old yearbook.
The fans yelled when their team scored.
She yelled for help when she saw the smoke.
The coach had to yell over the noise of the crowd.

easy.def: Having the color of a banana or the sun.

more.def: Having the color of a lemon, a banana or the sun.
examples: A yellow butterfly landed on the flower.
The school bus is bright yellow.
Her yellow raincoat shone in the rain.

easy.def: The color of a banana or the sun.
examples: Mix yellow and blue for green.

more.def: The color of lemons, bananas and sunflowers.
examples: The artist used yellow for the sun.
The field was a sea of yellow.

easy.def: A word you say to mean it is so.

more.def: A word used to agree, to accept an offer, or to say that something is true.
examples: Yes, I would love to come to your party.
Yes, the museum is open every day except Monday.
The teacher asked if we were ready, and we all said yes.
Yesterday we went to the park.

more.def: The day that came just before today.
examples: Yesterday was rainy, but today the sun is out.
I finished the book I started yesterday.
Yesterday's game was called off because of rain.

more.def: Up to this time, or by now.
examples: The bus has not come yet, so we are still waiting.
Have you finished your homework yet?
The flowers have not bloomed yet this spring.

easy.def: A big, hairy creature in stories.
examples: The yeti lives in the mountains.

more.def: A big, hairy creature in stories that is said to live in the snowy mountains.
examples: The yeti lives in the snowy mountains of the story.
